definition: [ שָׂרַךְ ] verb twist (so ᵑ7 סְרַךְ (= Hebrew עִוָּה , עִוֵּה ); perhaps akin to שׂרג , סרג ; Talmud סָרַךְ is adhere , compare Aramaic , ; Arabic is share, participate , but sandal-thong , snare ); — Pi`el Participle feminine singular מְשָׂרֶכֶת דְּרָכֶיהָ Jer 2:23 a swift dromedary entangling her ways (galloping aimlessly; figurative).

Pi`el Participle feminine singular מְשָׂרֶכֶת דְּרָכֶיהָ Jer 2:23 a swift dromedary entangling her ways (galloping aimlessly; figurative).
